entities.name: Jiří Crha
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Crha is a Czech former ice hockey goaltender. He played 69 games in the National Hockey League for the Toronto Maple Leafs between 1980 and 1981. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1969 to 1993, was spent first in the Czechoslovak First Ice Hockey League and then the German Eishockey-Bundesliga. Internationally Crha played for the Czechoslovak national team in several tournaments, including the 1976 Winter Olympics, where he won a silver medal.
